description: Update an add-on installed on an NKS cluster (version upgrade and/or configuration change). At least one of version, configurationValues or resolveConflicts must be supplied.

addonRef.description: Add-on name or the UUID of the installed add-on

configurationValues.description: Helm values override as a JSON string

resolveConflicts.description: How to handle fields already modified in the cluster: Overwrite (default) or Preserve

name: ncloud_nks_update_cluster_addon
